summary:
Implemented the grid-sampled patch feature in the MONAI repo, but nothing has been run: tests and linting were skipped per your instructions, so treat it as unverified until pytest runs.

Changes:
- monai/data/utils.py: iter_patch now yields (patch view, coordinate array) pairs, with coordinates computed from the padded slices minus the padding offset. set_rnd skips attribute names starting with "__". Docstring Yields and Note updated.
- monai/data/grid_dataset.py: new PatchIter (patch_size gets a whole-channel None prepended, start_pos via ensure_tuple, mode validated via NumpyPadMode, delegates to iter_patch with copy-back off). GridPatchDataset reworked to take dataset, patch_iter, transform, with_coordinates; worker split uses np.ceil; NotImplementedError("image dataset must implement `len()`.") when len() fails; transform applied via apply_transform(map_items=False). math import removed. PatchDataset docstring uses dtype=float.
- monai/data/__init__.py: exports PatchIter.
- docs/source/data.rst: PatchIter autodoc entry after GridPatchDataset.
- tests/test_grid_dataset.py: new TestGridPatchDataset with test_shape and test_loading_array, pinned values from the spec.

Unverified risks:
- The pinned values in test_loading_array depend on RNG draw order and on both test images being np.arange(16).reshape(1, 4, 4). The spec did not state image contents; I inferred them from the pinned values.
- The GridPatchDataset docstring example prints shapes only, not patch values.
- Line lengths were checked with awk only; black and flake8 were not run. Pre-existing long lines in get_valid_patch_size remain.

Nothing was committed.
